periodic_goal_read: 真实收件或 ACK 使用同一事务记录实际消费时间。新发显式周期 goal occurrence 由 typed marker 标记；仅当 marker 属于当前 armed 订阅、消息未读且 trigger 等于当前 due trigger 时计数一次。marker-less 历史记录沿用 legacy 聚合计数，历史被清理后不得从时间戳推断。有限周期提醒仅在下一原定时点已到或已过时，从实际消费时间顺延一个周期。保留原 TTL、剩余次数及已接受未读提醒；到期和取消的订阅不重启。
description: SESE consumption graph. A recipient consume request verifies the exact mailbox owner and the exact current recipient context, reads the current unread batch, then commits Delivered/Acked in one transaction. Any two registered objects may exchange ordinary messages across role and project; consumption still requires the exact recipient context, so a replaced Rex block owner or a stale generation cannot consume a message addressed to the newer current binding. recv returns every unread message once, marks the batch read, and exposes no receive replay or reply obligation. The fixed periodic retention owner later removes each read body and its delivery state. The ordinary CLI checks the current available batch and returns an empty result when none is available; only explicit --timeout N opts into waiting in the poll owner. An empty result does not create a consumption receipt. Upstream Rex notification admission, defined in collab-rex-adaptor.graph.json, requires a matching unique current owner and holds the shared host register gate across map validation, selection, synchronous sink and its original result. That gate serializes submission with binding replacement; it does not consume mail and this consumption path does not reacquire it. Native acceptance and received receipt are not consumption. Multiple peers in one Rex session consume only through their own block-bound current binding. New explicit periodic goal occurrences carry a typed marker owned by the timer/consumption transaction; marker-less historical records retain the legacy aggregate path. Consumption does not change route, transport or binding truth. A fixture or graph validation does not prove live LLM consumption; that requires a real agent recv and receipt.

nodes.description: Owner is the mailbox/name owner. Resolve the recipient from the exact current project/name binding, and when the request names a target execution binding, require that binding to still be the current one. Then accept only unread messages owned by that mailbox. A replaced Rex block owner, an old generation or a different peer in the same session is not the current recipient and must not consume through this path. Missing, mismatched, ambiguous or unreadable message identity keeps the existing explicit MESSAGE_ID_INVALID/MESSAGE_NOT_FOUND/MESSAGE_LOOKUP_FAILED result and does not consume. Native acceptance is not owner verification.

Owner is the durable unread mailbox payload reader. Project body, sender, and correlation come from the same durable unread message state. Reading, inbox projection or terminal echo does not consume the message and does not prove the agent received it. Receive IDs are client trace and reply obligations do not exist.

Owner is the mailbox consumption transaction. For the whole unread batch, commit Delivered/Acked using the same real received_ms and mark every row read. A new explicit periodic goal occurrence counts only when its typed marker belongs to the current armed subscription and its trigger equals the current due trigger; marker-less historical records retain the legacy aggregate path. A receive ID never replays a committed batch. Reading retained accepted mail after subscription expiry is valid, but it cannot revive that terminal schedule. Only this durable commit represents consumption; periodic retention later removes the read row. A late or old-generation receipt must not mark a newer binding consumed, and one peer's receipt must not consume another peer's same-session message. A real agent recv receipt is required for live LLM consumption; fixture and graph evidence are insufficient.
